method: Explicitly authorized supplement using fresh synthetic data only

findings.title: 删除账号未撤销已签发会话，旧Cookie仍可写入且跨服务重启有效
findings.expected: 忘记我删除账号后所有旧会话立即失效；强制登录API返回401，不能再创建已删除身份的数据。
findings.actual: A和公开API新建C均在forgotten=true、账号记录删除和密码登录401之后，旧Cookie仍authenticated=true且POST会话201；C在重启后仍可读新建记录。
findings.reproducibility: Two independently created synthetic accounts; public-API-only C reproduction and real restart confirmed.
findings.limits: Requires possession of an already-issued valid cookie. No cookie signature forgery, no cross-account content disclosure, old messages were deleted.
findings.recommendation: Central server-validated identity: account active/existing and session not revoked; delete account revokes all issued sessions.

findings.title: 普通退出清除当前浏览器，但未撤销提前保留的合法Cookie副本
findings.expected: Security target: logout revokes the current login session including copies of its token.
findings.actual: B当前客户端退出后401；同次登录Cookie副本仍GET会话列表200。
findings.reproducibility: One controlled synthetic B login/copy/logout sequence.
findings.limits: Classified as a revocation design target, not an undocumented signature bypass or credential-free account takeover.
findings.recommendation: Issue revocable session IDs and revoke the current session on logout; use user session version or all-session revocation on deletion.
